titulo: Signs of progress after US envoys Witkoff and Kushner hold talks in Ukraine?
cuerpo: US peace envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff heralded new momentum in peace talks after meeting Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy in Kyiv on Sunday as the Trump administration renewed its push to end Russia's four-and-a-half-year war in Ukraine. But while there maybe some tentative signs that the proposals from the US team are more to Ukraine’s liking than those previously put forward, what Moscow thinks is still unclear, says France 24’s Oliver Farry.
